mapper.select: select count(case when create_time between #{begin} and #{end} then 1 end) from sky_take_out.user union all select count(case when create_time < #{end} then 1 end) from sky_take_out.user

select n.name as name, count(n.name) as total from ( select d.name from sky_take_out.order_detail d left join sky_take_out.orders o on d.order_id = o.id where o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end} and o.status = 5 ) as n group by n.name order by total desc limit 10
select count(*) as orderCount from sky_take_out.orders union all select count(case when status = 5 then 1 end) as validOrderCount from sky_take_out.orders;
